name: THF Grants (The Habitat Foundation)
summary: Annual grants from a Malaysian foundation for conservation, research, education, sustainability and training projects, including species protection and protected area management. The 2026 round is closed; the next cycle is not yet announced.

steps: Subject matter specialist consultation or applicant interview
Executive Committee review of shortlisted grants

eligibility.rule: Project has a clear pathway to practical application to conservation or community benefit

documents: Subject or site of interest photos
Project or organisation logo, if dedicated logo exists

status.quote: THF Grants 2026 applications are now closed.

applicant_types.quote: The THF Grants are intended for individuals and organisations

geography.quote: We only support projects that are carried out in Malaysia

access.quote: The Habitat Foundation is now calling for applications for its THF Grants.

window.quote: stay connected with us through our website and social media for updates on the next grant cycle

amount.quote: The size of the grants ranges from RM15,000 to RM50,000.

effort.quote: Subject matter specialists consulted/ interviews with applicants
Shortlisted grants reviewed by Executive Committee

eligibility.quote: We do not support purely academic or theoretical studies with no clear pathway to practical application to conservation or community benefit.

documents.quote: Upload a well-lit and clear front-face profile photo (preferably taken in the field)

For applicants working on a specific species or group of organisms (plants, animals, cyanobacteria etc), submit photo(s) of the subject. For applicants working on a landscape level, a drone or wide-angle photo of the area is strongly encouraged 3. Work-in-Progress Shot For proposals requesting support for ongoing initiatives, please include action shots that showcase aspects of the proposed work.
Only required for organisations or project's that have a dedicated logo.
